hints.title: Contiguous Slices
hints.text: Consecutive indices in the spaces array define the exact bounds of each word slice.

hints.title: Single Pass Assembly
hints.text: Extract segments from previous space index up to current space index and join with spaces.

hints.title: Trailing Segment Handling
hints.text: Append the remainder of the original string following the final space index.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Spaces are 0-indexed positions before which spaces should be inserted.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeated string insertions at arbitrary positions take quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Appending substrings between consecutive space indices builds the result in linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should slice or stream characters into a buffer in one pass.
